landing.heroTitle: For a pioneering mother and a promising child
landing.heroLede: An educational platform that brings together programmes and lessons in knowledge, culture and society, aiming to promote sustainable development and social progress, and open to adults, teenagers and children.
landing.tileProgramsText: Categories, levels and subjects, and the memorisation syllabus for each level.
landing.tileCalendarText: Class and activity times at each centre, in both Hijri and Gregorian dates.
landing.tileLibraryText: Lessons, files and recordings open to all, organised by category and level.
landing.missionLede: We believe every woman has a share of knowledge, whatever her age or circumstances. That is why we open our circles to adults before children, and follow each learner's progress individually and on record — not merely as attendance in a register.
landing.stagesLede: Our educational work is divided into three stages, each with its own levels, circles and weekly times.
landing.stageAdultBody: Circles for memorising and revising the Holy Qur'an, lessons in the Islamic sciences, and literacy classes for those who did not have the chance to learn when young.
landing.stageAdultMeta: Includes a literacy level and memorisation levels
landing.stageTeenBody: A programme balancing memorisation of the Holy Qur'an with understanding its meanings, with lessons suited to adolescence and the demands of regular schooling.
landing.stageChildBody: An early foundation in reading and memorisation in an enjoyable way, under the supervision of instructors and followed by parents through their own accounts.
landing.howTitle: Three steps to your first circle
landing.howLede: No prior visit is needed to register; the whole application can be completed from a phone.
landing.step1Body: Sign-in is through a Google account only, with no passwords to remember or forget.
landing.step2Body: One form is filled in for the learner, or for a parent and child together, with the required consents given explicitly.
landing.step3Body: An association supervisor reviews the application; once approved, the account is opened and assigned to the right branch and circle.
landing.footerRights: All rights reserved — Bodour Al Amal Association

install.title: Install Bodour Al Amal on your device
install.note: The app is the platform itself: it opens from an icon on the screen without the browser bar, and needs the internet just like the website.
install.ios.lede: On iPhone and iPad, installation is done from the Safari browser:
install.ios.step1: Tap the “Share” button in the Safari bar (a square with an arrow pointing up).
install.ios.step2: Scroll down the menu and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
install.ios.step3: Tap “Add”. The Bodour Al Amal icon will appear on the screen.
install.manual.lede: Installation is done from the browser menu:
install.manual.step1: Open the browser menu (the three dots ⋮ at the top or bottom of the screen).
install.manual.step2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home Screen”.
install.manual.step3: Confirm the installation. The Bodour Al Amal icon will appear on the screen.

content.edit.additionalLevelsHint: The level above is the level of the original file. Add here the other levels it concerns — a recording of a class that brought two levels together, for example — so their learners can see it too if it is private. The subject must be taught at every chosen level.
